requirements: canonical_digest excludes only the top-level digest field
impact: Generating valid execution-input fixtures under both rules would require finding a 48-bit hash fixed point. Repeated rehashing does not resolve the contract.
recommended_resolution: Exclude top-level digest and normalize input_id to the identity prefix before its final @ suffix when hashing; retain identity in the digest.
alternative_resolution: Exclude top-level digest and input_id entirely when hashing.
downstream: P2.1 Task brief digest generation must follow the same corrected algorithm.
owner_answer: При хэшировании исключать digest и суффикс input_id после @; сохранять в хэше идентификатор задания (рекомендовано)
